connections.quote: Interface ID: IF-AIR-04 | From: DUCT-OUT-201 | From Port / Signal: port_b | To: BND-201 | To Port / Signal: airPort | Item / Quantity: Room air + CO2 | Direction: Duct -> boundary | Units: kg/s | Constraint / Semantics: Ideal pressure boundary.

Interface ID: IF-TRC-01 | From: SRC-CO2-201 | From Port / Signal: tracePort | To: ZON-201 | To Port / Signal: traceInjection | Item / Quantity: CO2 trace substance | Direction: Source -> room | Units: kg/s CO2 | Constraint / Semantics: Actual CO2 addition = carrier m_flow * C_source.

Interface ID: IF-SIG-01 | From: SCH-OCC-201 | From Port / Signal: nPeo | To: GAIN-PEO-201 | To Port / Signal: u | Item / Quantity: People count | Direction: Schedule -> gain | Units: person | Constraint / Semantics: Piecewise constant integer count.

Interface ID: IF-SIG-02 | From: GAIN-PEO-201 | From Port / Signal: y | To: SRC-CO2-201 | To Port / Signal: m_flow | Item / Quantity: Carrier mass flow | Direction: Gain -> source | Units: kg/s | Constraint / Semantics: Gain = 8.18E-6/100 per person.

Interface ID: IF-SIG-03 | From: SET-OA-201 | From Port / Signal: C_out | To: SRC-OA-201 | To Port / Signal: C | Item / Quantity: Outdoor CO2 mass fraction | Direction: Constant -> source | Units: kg/kg | Constraint / Semantics: 300 ppm = 0.3*C_nominal.

Interface ID: IF-SIG-04 | From: ZON-201 | From Port / Signal: C_room | To: SEN-CO2-201 | To Port / Signal: medium | Item / Quantity: Room trace concentration | Direction: Room -> sensor | Units: kg/kg | Constraint / Semantics: Ideal sensor in baseline.

Interface ID: IF-SIG-05 | From: SEN-CO2-201 | From Port / Signal: C | To: GAIN-NORM-201 | To Port / Signal: u | Item / Quantity: Measured CO2 | Direction: Sensor -> gain | Units: kg/kg | Constraint / Semantics: Normalize by 1/1.519E-3.

Interface ID: IF-SIG-06 | From: GAIN-NORM-201 | From Port / Signal: y | To: CTL-CO2-201 | To Port / Signal: measurement | Item / Quantity: Normalized CO2 | Direction: Gain -> controller | Units: normalized | Constraint / Semantics: 1.0 corresponds to 1000 ppm.

Interface ID: IF-SIG-07 | From: SET-CO2-201 | From Port / Signal: setpoint | To: CTL-CO2-201 | To Port / Signal: setpoint | Item / Quantity: Normalized setpoint | Direction: Constant -> controller | Units: normalized | Constraint / Semantics: Value = 1.0.

Interface ID: IF-SIG-08 | From: CTL-CO2-201 | From Port / Signal: ACH_cmd | To: GAIN-AIR-201 | To Port / Signal: u | Item / Quantity: Air-change command | Direction: Controller -> gain | Units: 1/h | Constraint / Semantics: Limited to 0.2..6 ACH.

Interface ID: IF-SIG-09 | From: GAIN-AIR-201 | From Port / Signal: m_flow_cmd | To: SRC-OA-201 | To Port / Signal: m_flow | Item / Quantity: Source mass-flow command | Direction: Gain -> fresh air | Units: kg/s | Constraint / Semantics: m_flow_cmd = -ACH*100*1.2/3600.
